|rulings=* Once during each Dark's turns, Dark may place a card from hand face down under the Bluffs site (this is called a bluff card).<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Tatooine: Bluffs (GEMP ID 2_150, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), records these seven later Bluff Rules statements, including the claim that declining deployment costs 2 Force. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 159, says a revealed character or vehicle may attempt to deploy and imposes the penalty if the card is not one of those types or could not legally deploy; it does not expressly settle voluntary refusal of an otherwise legal deployment. That specific claim remains unresolved here, rather than independently verified by the rulebook. Decipher's [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Glossary Version 2.0] (November 1998), p. 28, gives different earlier rules for reveal timing, eligible characters and Expand The Empire. This citation attributes the later record without treating it as the original-era rule set or resolving the refusal question. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Tatooine%3A%20Bluffs Scomp: Tatooine: Bluffs].</ref>
* Dark's Force drains at Bluffs are +1 for each bluff card.
* During Dark's deploy phase, Light may choose to reveal any of Dark's bluff cards (may reveal multiple in the same deploy phase).
* If a revealed card is a character or vehicle, Dark may attempt to deploy it (using deploy cost = 0) to the Bluffs; normal deployment rules apply including needing presence or Force icons.
* If the revealed card is not deployed for any reason (card is not a character/vhicle, deployment was not possible, Dark chooses not to deploy), Dark loses 2 Force and the bluff card.
* [[Revolution]] does not change anything (Dark still bluffs, not Light).
* [[Expand The Empire]] does not change anything (bluffing is only possible at the Bluffs site).
